Wayanad landslide: Death toll reaches five, investigations launched

A landslide in Wayanad has resulted in five confirmed deaths, with three individuals still missing. The incident has led to the suspension of tunnel road construction in the area. The Kerala government has announced an ex gratia payment for the victims' families and formed expert panels to investigate the tragedy and oversee debris removal.
